**Root cause:** The prompt requested citation objects but didn’t show the required nested document structure. Groq’s `json_object` mode ensures syntactically valid JSON, not schema adherence, so the model could return document fields without complete citation objects. The reported Zod paths are consistent with that mismatch. [Groq JSON modes](https://console.groq.com/docs/structured-outputs)

I changed [investigation.ts](/mnt/d/Aristo/src/lib/investigation.ts) to spell out the complete cited-fact shape, include a compact synthetic example for contracts, purchase orders, and invoices, and request Groq strict JSON Schema output. Model output still goes through identity reconciliation, Zod validation, exact quote and page checks, and the deterministic audit; missing facts are never filled in. The output cap remains 1,800 tokens: the three-document example needs an estimated 1,200–1,500 output tokens, and Groq’s published free-tier table lists an 8K TPM limit for this model. [Groq rate limits](https://console.groq.com/docs/rate-limits)
